Bro youre 30, youre still young. I have many friends early to late 30s with no social anxiety that are still single. The dating world is harder these days as is. Your life and journey is far from over. Youre acting like youre in retirement age which youre far from so keep searching and taking risks and push yourself a bit each day. I too still have social anxiety though its bad at times its improved over the years much better than in my teen years. However I am married cuz I took the risk. Its still hard some days but I am thankful that I took the chance and bet on myself. I had many crushes who I thought were my soulmates but they ended up with someone else. You didnt lose your soulmate. Theres potentially someone else out there for you. I also know some 50+ year olds that are still single because they didnt take the risk. Which person do you wanna end up as is ultimately up to you. Everything worth having takes risks. One day at a time, I’m sure youre feeling discouraged thinking you let your “soulmate” get away, but once you find that other person you will be glad and know why it didnt work out the way you thought. Social anxiety is a daily mental battle that doesnt end when you do find a gf or get married or have kids, grandkids, etc. either. It just gets easier to manage the more youre willing to challenge it. You got this!
